title: A decline-only cursor write at the end of a pass could replace the cursor of a placement that committed but whose commit reply was lost
resolution: The end-of-pass write now uses a conditional PlacementRotation.advanceFrom that stores the move only while the stored cursor is still the one the pass read; adapters, a conformance case, a lost-commit regression test, contract, spec, and design follow.

title: The design said every offer of a pass moves the cursor, which is not the rule after the stop at the first fleet decline
resolution: The design now states that each placement sets the cursor and that only a pass without a placement moves it, to its last own-reason decline before the fleet decline or outage.

title: The rationale against deriving the cursor from assignments claimed every own-reason decline leaves no record, though a rejecting reason commits the end of the attempt
resolution: The rationale now covers only the declines that roll back or commit no assignment and names the rejecting-reason path through endRejectedAttempt.

title: The value comparison of the conditional end-of-pass write cannot tell an unchanged cursor from a committed placement of the cursor's own project hidden behind a lost commit reply
resolution: A pass that an outage stops makes no end-of-pass write, so its decline-only move is lost instead; a regression test, a unit test, contract section 13, the requirement, and design D6 and D8 say so.

title: Scripted placements did not write the cursor, so the unit tests named for the placement transaction passed through the end-of-pass write
resolution: The scripted transaction now advances the cursor to the task's project whenever it answers a placement, as the placement transaction does.

title: The cursorStored flag of a placed result was always true for the service, a test seam inside the production type
resolution: Removed the flag and the extra placed constant; every placement the pass sees counts as stored.

title: No unit test covered the end-of-pass handling of a decline-only move in a pass that an outage stops
resolution: Added a unit test that a pass stopped by an outage writes no decline-only move; it fails on the earlier service.

title: The record still said the findings and pass summary files are empty after pass 1 filled them
resolution: The plan checklist entry now states what the two files hold.

title: Design D2 cited the PostgreSQL rotation class line for the advance method
resolution: D2 cites the advance method's line, and every file and line citation of the records was checked again at the fix revision.

title: ADR 0015 still cites the removed in-memory cursor field of the placement service
resolution: Left to the coordinator at integration, who can mark the ADR 0015 decision 5 follow-up as landed with its pull request number.
